block.usage:
usage: todo-db block [-h] --reason REASON [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                     [--repository REPOSITORY]
                     id

check-scope.usage:
usage: todo-db check-scope [-h] [--base BASE] [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                           [--repository REPOSITORY]
                           id [files ...]

claim.usage:
usage: todo-db claim [-h] [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                     id

args.help: skip the verification ladder and record this override reason in the completion audit event

complete.usage:
usage: todo-db complete [-h] [--pr PR] [--override-verification REASON]
                        [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                        id

create.usage:
usage: todo-db create [-h] [--from - | FILE] [--title TITLE]
                      [--worktree WORKTREE]
                      [--priority {critical,high,medium-high,medium,low}]
                      [--description DESCRIPTION] [--category CATEGORY]
                      [--approach APPROACH] [--work WID:SUMMARY[:needs=w1,w2]]
                      [--needs NEEDS] [--only-modify ONLY_MODIFY]
                      [--do-not-modify DO_NOT_MODIFY] [--preserve PRESERVE]
                      [--verify DESC[::COMMAND[::EXPECTED]]]
                      [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                      [id]

defer.usage:
usage: todo-db defer [-h] --summary SUMMARY --reason REASON
                     [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                     id

deps.usage:
usage: todo-db deps [-h] [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                    id

dismiss.usage:
usage: todo-db dismiss [-h] --reason REASON [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                       [--repository REPOSITORY]
                       deferral_id

args.help: also probe the hosted read-write connection

done.usage:
usage: todo-db done [-h] --evidence EVIDENCE [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                    [--repository REPOSITORY]
                    id wid

drop.usage:
usage: todo-db drop [-h] --reason REASON [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                    [--repository REPOSITORY]
                    id

export.usage:
usage: todo-db export [-h] [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                      --output OUTPUT

import-yaml.usage:
usage: todo-db import-yaml [-h] --todo-dir TODO_DIR [--done-dir DONE_DIR]
                           [--skip-done] [--dry-run] [--verbose] [--replace]
                           [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]

args.help: local path (default .todo-db/standalone.sqlite) or libsql:// URL, recorded in the config file
also write an executable wrapper script (default location _project/scripts/todo)

usage: todo-db init-project [-h] [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                            [--repository REPOSITORY] [--db DB]
                            [--wrapper [PATH]] [--force]

list.usage:
usage: todo-db list [-h] [--fields FIELDS] [--limit LIMIT]

                    [--worktree WORKTREE]
                    [--priority {critical,high,medium-high,medium,low}]

                    [--repository REPOSITORY]

promote.usage:

                       [--worktree WORKTREE] [--description DESCRIPTION]
                       [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]

args.help: comma-separated list of fields to project for list, ready, and show

ready.usage:

release.usage:

usage: todo-db show [-h] [--fields FIELDS] [--limit LIMIT]
                    [--max-bytes MAX_BYTES] [--json] [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                    [--repository REPOSITORY]
                    id

start.usage:
usage: todo-db start [-h] [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                     id wid

sweep-stale.usage:
usage: todo-db sweep-stale [-h] [--ttl-hours TTL_HOURS]
                           [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]

unblock.usage:
usage: todo-db unblock [-h] [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                       [--repository REPOSITORY]
                       id

args.help: required for any edit to a done/dropped item, scope change, or a drop of verify/needs/preserve/anti-pattern/prior-art/work-need

update.usage:
usage: todo-db update [-h] [--title TITLE] [--description DESCRIPTION]
                      [--priority {critical,high,medium-high,medium,low}]
                      [--worktree WORKTREE] [--approach APPROACH]
                      [--category CATEGORY]
                      [--add-work WID:SUMMARY[:needs=w1,w2]]
                      [--edit-work WID:NEW-SUMMARY]
                      [--add-work-need WID:NEEDS_WID]
                      [--drop-work-need WID:NEEDS_WID]
                      [--add-verify DESC[::COMMAND[::EXPECTED]]]
                      [--drop-verify SEQ] [--add-only-modify GLOB]
                      [--drop-only-modify GLOB] [--add-do-not-modify GLOB]
                      [--drop-do-not-modify GLOB] [--add-needs ITEM]
                      [--drop-needs ITEM] [--add-preserve BEHAVIOR]
                      [--drop-preserve BEHAVIOR]
                      [--add-anti-pattern DONT -- because WHY -- INSTEAD]
                      [--drop-anti-pattern DONT]
                      [--add-prior-art PATH::CONCEPT::reuse|extend|supersede]
                      [--drop-prior-art PATH::CONCEPT] [--reason REASON]
                      [--project-id PROJECT_ID] [--repository REPOSITORY]
                      id

verify.usage:
usage: todo-db verify [-h] [--run RUN] [--project-id PROJECT_ID]
                      [--repository REPOSITORY]
                      id

exit_codes.0: success (doctor: every check passed; warnings allowed)
exit_codes.1: findings reported (check-scope violations, lint findings, verify --run failures)
exit_codes.2: generic error, or legacy-safe auth failure before the v2 contract is negotiated
exit_codes.4: hosted authentication failure under TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2: set a valid bounded
